description: Prepare checkout from product feed item IDs and quantities without account login. For guests, call create_cart first and supply its guest_token. Optional item metadata is not authoritative. Returns a Tanatasa review link. Use get_checkout and set_checkout_details for buyer-approved delivery details, then prepare_payment after explicit approval of the current details and total. Supply a new idempotency_key per purchase and retain it and guest_token on retries.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: checkout_session
